datasetDef: Heterogeneous graph: 19 disorders + 83 regions + 7 Yeo networks; 257 distinct disorder-region pairs from the curated assertions (positives) + region-network membership edges. Disorder-region edges are TYPED by evidence modality category (imaging / electrophysiology / stimulation), one GCN relation each; same split and seed as linkpred_rgcn_v1 for direct comparison. Study nodes excluded from the graph to prevent study-mediated train/test leakage.
preprocessing: Assertions collapsed to distinct disorder-region pairs; 70/15/15 pair-level split (179/38/40); message passing on train pairs only; seeded evaluation negatives disjoint from all positives. Caveat: training negatives exclude ALL positives (incl. held-out ones), and evaluation negatives can recur as training negatives — both make reported AUC/AP mildly optimistic.
model: 2-layer relational GCN over 4 relations (learned 32-d node embeddings, per-relation mean aggregation, dot-product decoder), BCE with 5 sampled negatives/positive, Adam lr=0.01, early stopping on validation ROC-AUC (best epoch 343). PyTorch 2.13.0, CPU.
